requires.note: Database connection is configured via a full connection string in the 'database' field. Host/port/user/password are embedded in the connection string rather than separate fields.
Cache backend is configured via a full backend_url in the 'cache' field. Host/port are embedded in the URL.

Notification driver (messagingv2) implies a message queue, but specific host/port/user/password are not present as separate schema fields. They are assumed to be handled by global messaging configuration or defaults.
Keystone integration may require LDAP/Directory, but no explicit fields are present for this in the schema.
